label: 11月12日
subtitle: 十二月加息几成定局 · 日元跌到两个月低点 · 全球增长押在一件事上

briefs.en: Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to remove Jensen Huang as chief executive, after he acknowledged an affair with a woman US officials suspect worked for Beijing.
briefs.cn: 据报道,英伟达董事会正准备让黄仁勋卸任首席执行官;此前他承认与一名女子有婚外情,而美国官员怀疑该女子为北京方面工作。

briefs.en: American consumer prices rose 0.4% from September to October, about a tenth of a point above forecasts, making a December rate increase close to certain.
briefs.cn: 美国消费者价格 9 月到 10 月上涨 0.4%,比预测高约 0.1 个百分点,12 月加息几乎已成定局。

briefs.en: The yen slipped to 159.07 against the dollar, its weakest since early September, as traders priced in a faster pace of Fed increases.
briefs.cn: 日元兑美元跌到 159.07,为 9 月初以来最弱,因为交易员开始押注美联储加息的步子会更快。

briefs.en: Pfizer signed a $1.5 billion agreement with Blackstone to help fund the development of a weight-loss drug.
briefs.cn: 辉瑞与黑石签了一份 15 亿美元的协议,用于资助一款减肥药的研发。

briefs.en: United Airlines is blocking AI bots from booking flights on its website, drawing a line between customers and the software acting for them.
briefs.cn: 联合航空开始阻止 AI 机器人在自家网站上订票,把顾客和替顾客跑腿的软件区分开来。

deep.title: A lot of growth resting on one line of spending
deep.titleCn: 一大片增长,压在一项开支上

sentences.en: Much of the world's growth this year has leaned on one thing: American spending on data centers.
sentences.cn: 今年全球的增长,很大一部分靠着一件事撑住:美国在数据中心上的开支。

sentences.en: Asian exporters have thrived selling chips and server racks, and assembly hubs from Vietnam to Mexico have been pulled along with them.
sentences.cn: 亚洲出口商靠卖芯片和服务器机架过得很好,从越南到墨西哥的组装基地也被一起带了起来。

sentences.en: China's exports rose 35% in October from a year earlier, and South Korea's were up 93%.
sentences.cn: 中国 10 月出口同比增长 35%,韩国增长 93%。

sentences.en: But economists now point out how narrow that base is: by one estimate, as much as 80% of recent export growth came from AI-related goods.
sentences.cn: 但经济学家现在指出,这个基础有多窄:据一种估算,近期出口增长中高达八成来自与 AI 相关的商品。

sentences.en: Should American firms slow their spending, the effect would not stay inside the technology sector.
sentences.cn: 万一美国公司放慢开支,影响不会只停在科技行业里面。

sentences.en: The dot-com bust offers a rough yardstick: American imports of IT equipment, measured against the size of the economy, fell 55% in the two years after mid-2000, and world growth slipped to about 2% in 2001.
sentences.cn: 互联网泡沫破裂提供了一把粗略的尺子:美国 IT 设备进口相对于经济体量,在 2000 年年中之后的两年里下降了 55%,2001 年全球增长滑到约 2%。

sentences.en: Nobody is forecasting that outcome; the point is that there is little left to cushion it.
sentences.cn: 没有人在预测那样的结果;真正的问题是,现在几乎没有什么东西能缓冲它。

notes: 靠一件事撑着。比 depend on 更形象,有「把重量压上去」的意思。
have been pulled along with them
被一起带了起来。写受益于别人的增长时很好用,不必说 benefit from。
point out how narrow that base is
指出这个基础有多窄。how + 形容词 + 主语 + be,把评价塞进宾语从句。
据一种估算。不说是谁估的,但承认这只是一家之言 —— 写论文里不确定的数字也可以这么处理。
高达八成。as much as 给的是上限,比直接写 80% 留了余地。
Should American firms slow their spending, ...
万一……。把 if 去掉、should 提前,是条件句的正式写法,比 If American firms should... 干净。
提供一把粗略的尺子。拿历史事件做参照时的标准说法,rough 先替自己打了折扣。
Nobody is forecasting that outcome; the point is that ...
先否掉最极端的读法,再说真正想说的。这个转折能让论断显得克制而不是唱衰。

vocab.ex: The board is reportedly preparing to replace the chief executive.
vocab.exCn: 据报道,董事会正准备换掉这位首席执行官。
vocab.tip: 放在 be 动词之后、实义动词之前。用了它就等于说「这不是我核实的」,是最省事的免责词。

vocab.ex: Officials allege that the executive was recruited by a foreign government.
vocab.exCn: 官员指称这名高管被某外国政府招募。
vocab.tip: 专用于「有人这么说、但还没证实」的不当行为。形容词 alleged 放在名词前:the alleged scandal。读作 uh-LEJ。

vocab.ex: He acknowledged the relationship but denied any wrongdoing.
vocab.exCn: 他承认了这段关系,但否认有任何不当行为。
vocab.tip: 和 allege 正好相反:allege 是别人说,acknowledge 是当事人自己认。比 admit 中性,不带「认罪」的味道。

vocab.ex: The global economy looks vulnerable to an AI bust.
vocab.exCn: 全球经济看起来经不住一次 AI 崩盘。
vocab.tip: 总是和 boom 配对出现:boom and bust(一荣一崩)。比 crash 更强调「泡沫吹起来之后破掉」。

vocab.ex: The dot-com bust offers a rough yardstick for what could follow.
vocab.exCn: 互联网泡沫破裂为接下来可能发生的事提供了一把粗略的尺子。
vocab.tip: 原意是一码长的木尺。拿历史或别的案例做参照时用,前面常加 rough 或 useful。

vocab.ex: Global growth has leaned heavily on data-center spending.
vocab.exCn: 全球增长在很大程度上靠数据中心的开支撑着。
vocab.tip: 比 depend on 形象:身体往上靠,靠的东西一撤就倒。也有「施压」的意思,看语境。

vocab.ex: Governments have little room left to cushion a downturn.
vocab.exCn: 政府几乎没有余地去缓冲一次下行。
vocab.tip: 名词是垫子,动词是垫一下。常见搭配 cushion the blow(减轻冲击)。

vocab.ex: A chorus of hawkish comments from officials lifted the dollar.
vocab.exCn: 官员们一片主张加息的表态推高了美元。
vocab.tip: 鹰派 = 优先压通胀、愿意加息;反面是 dovish(鸽派,优先保增长、倾向降息)。

vocab.ex: The central bank raised rates by 25 basis points.
vocab.tip: 一个基点 = 0.01 个百分点,100 个基点 = 1%。用它是为了避开「百分点涨了百分之几」这种歧义。口语缩写 bps,读作 bips。

vocab.ex: Core inflation, which strips out food and energy, rose 0.3%.
vocab.exCn: 剔除食品和能源的核心通胀上涨 0.3%。
vocab.tip: 把价格波动最大的食品和能源拿掉之后的通胀,用来看长期趋势。注意配单数动词。

vocab.ex: Repeated intervention has failed to turn the tide for the currency.
vocab.exCn: 一再干预仍没能扭转这个货币的走势。
vocab.tip: 汇市里特指政府或央行自己下场买卖本币。动词 intervene,重音在最后一节。

vocab.ex: The jump in US yields spilled over into the Japanese bond market.
vocab.exCn: 美国收益率的跳升波及到了日本债券市场。
vocab.tip: 水满了溢出去。名词写成一个词:spillover effects(外溢效应)。

patterns.title: 这消息哪来的,有几分实
patterns.intro: 今天的头条全是没坐实的事。英文新闻靠一组固定的词把「谁说的、证没证实」交代清楚 —— 用错一个,就从报道变成指控。
rows: reportedly
据报道,不点来源,最轻
The board is reportedly preparing to replace its chief executive.
according to people familiar with the matter
据知情人士,匿名来源的标准写法
The talks are at an early stage, according to people familiar with the matter.
alleged / allegedly
被指称的,涉及不当行为且未证实
The alleged scandal has unsettled the company's investors.
suspected
被怀疑是某种身份,还没定性
She is a suspected agent of a foreign government.
acknowledged
当事人自己承认了,这部分算坐实
He acknowledged the relationship in a note to employees.
declined to comment
拒绝置评,表示你去问过了
Both companies declined to comment on the report.

drill.q: 把这句译成英文:「据报道,董事会正准备换掉这位首席执行官。」
drill.a: The board is reportedly preparing to replace the chief executive.
drill.hint: reportedly 放在 is 后面、动词前面。

patterns.title: 这事到底几成把握
patterns.intro: 从「几乎板上钉钉」到「不太可能」,英文有一整排刻度。挑准了,读者就知道你有多大把握。
rows: is a near certainty / close to certain
九成以上,就差官宣
A December rate increase is now close to certain.
stands poised to
万事俱备,随时动手
The central bank stands poised to raise rates again next month.
is likely to
多半会,但留了口子
A quick return to the 2% target is unlikely.
could / may
可能,不表态有多大可能
Stronger inflation could warrant a faster pace of increases.
risks + doing
有变成某种局面的风险
Global trade risks becoming hostage to a single industry.
looks overdone
市场反应过头了
Talk of a half-point move looks overdone.

drill.q: 填空:A December increase is now a near ____, and the Fed stands ____ to move again early next year.
drill.hint: 第一个是名词「确定的事」,第二个和 stands 搭配表示蓄势待发。

patterns.title: 把断言往回收一点
patterns.intro: 这一组对写论文一样有用:同样的结论,换个动词就从「我断定」变成「证据指向」。
rows: appear / seem to
看上去是这样
Investors appear to think the selloff has gone too far.
suggest
数据或迹象「说明」,不等于证明
The rebound suggests many investors see the selloff as overdone.
point to
指向某个方向
Global data point to the boom still going strong.
look vulnerable to
看起来经不住
The global economy looks vulnerable to an AI bust.
Should X ..., ...
万一……,倒装条件句,比 if 正式
Should the boom collapse, little could be done to prevent a recession.
by one estimate / as much as
据一种估算 / 高达,给上限不写死
By one estimate, as much as 80% of the growth came from one sector.

drill.q: 造一句:据一种估算,近期出口增长中高达八成来自 AI 相关商品。
drill.a: By one estimate, as much as 80% of recent export growth came from AI-related goods.
drill.hint: 两个留余地的说法叠在一起:by one estimate 管来源,as much as 管上限。

quiz.q: He ____ the relationship in a note to employees, which settles at least that part of the story.
quiz.why: 当事人自己认的用 acknowledge。allege 是别人指称且未证实,suspect 是怀疑,reported 是第三方报道。

quiz.q: ____ the boom collapse, little could be done to prevent a recession.
quiz.why: Should 提到句首就是「万一」,后面不再加 if。Unless 意思相反,Whether 不能带条件。

quiz.q: Talk of a half-point move looks ____.
quiz.why: overdone 是「做过头了」,说市场反应过度的标准词。另外三个分别是被超过、被推翻、被偷听到。

quiz.q: A December increase is now a near ____, and the Fed stands ____ to move again early next year.
quiz.why: a near certainty 是名词短语「几乎确定的事」;stand poised to 表示蓄势待发,poised 不要写成 posed。

quiz.q: 把这句译成英文:「据一种估算,近期出口增长中高达八成来自与 AI 相关的商品。」
quiz.a: By one estimate, as much as 80% of recent export growth came from AI-related goods.
quiz.why: 两个留余地的说法叠用:by one estimate 交代这只是一家之言,as much as 表示这是上限。也可以写 Up to 80% of ... by one estimate.
